messages.author: 91481440fd4fef18
messages.subject: access to function bin
parts:
Dear all,

I recently upgraded ggplot2. Before I was a happy user of the bin function which I use to pre-compute some values and then plot. Now this function seems to be buried in the StatBin object. Is there anyway to access the functionality outside of a plot call?

Cheers,
Moritz

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: access to function bin
parts:
I found this the other day... I think you use 
require(ggplot2)
ggplot2:::bin()
